entities.name: Query acetylglutamate kinase
observations: 294 aa protein; exact full-length sequence hash match to reviewed UniProt A6UR56 acetylglutamate kinase.
Belongs to the AA_kinase family (Pfam PF00696; positions 24–270).
Curated homologs identify EC 2.7.2.8 acetylglutamate kinase activity and cytoplasmic localization.
Sequence evidence supports ATP binding and participation in L-arginine biosynthesis.

entities.name: N-acetyl-L-glutamate phosphorylation
observations: This is the second step of the N-acetyl-L-ornithine route to L-arginine from L-glutamate.

entities.name: L-arginine biosynthesis
observations: Acetylglutamate kinase catalyzes step 2/4 in the pathway producing N(2)-acetyl-L-ornithine from L-glutamate.
